received_works.body:
Hello! I was wondering if you could draw my cats, I am trying to get the photo printed and hung up in my home :) Thank you!

https://imgur.com/a/TAfS6RJ

こんにちは！
ご多忙中申し訳ありませんが、もし宜ければ個人観賞用のOCカップルのイラストをお願いしたいと思います。
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-wgQhwOWWF0oBSsGRareIH6aIKVvfrQP?usp=sharing   

【リクエスト】
可能であれば、2人の動物化イラストをお願いしたいと思います。
ピンク髪の子=犬、黄色い髪の子=狐みたいな感じをお願いします。(狐は犬よりサイズが大きいと思います)

迷惑をかけたら、気軽にキャンセルしてください。
ご検討のほどよろしくお願いします。

https://sta.sh/21wsg1sj32gv?edit=1

Nice to meet you!
I would like to request a drawing for my friend. 
My friend really liked your work you did here (https://skeb.jp/@arigatao_o/works/6), and wanted to have a similar drawing for his character!
Could you draw a hedgehog in a knight armor eating some muffins or a cupcake? The setting would be in a medieval/fantasy world.
I would like the hedgehog to have a happy and excited expression, similar to the image in the reference URL.

The finished piece would be used for streaming so if it's possible, can you make the drawing in a resolution of 16:9?

Thank you for your consideration. ♥

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ml8oQC8fVIH_0eeROzuSyRns8VB-c1ix?usp=sharing

Nice to meet you.
I'm in love with the cute animals you draw, and I'd like to make a request.

What I would like you to draw is a black shiba and a cream-colored rabbit having a picnic.
I'd like the black bush and the rabbit to be about the same size, or the rabbit could be a little bigger if it doesn't look out of place.
The food that gatao draws always looks delicious, so I'd be happy if he could include something.

The original images of the animals are Ryota and Seishiro from the following URL...

https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/83591659

https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/90959354

We hope you will consider it.

Hello! I'd love to get a piece of my three dogs in 16:9/wallpaper size please :)

Maya: Schnauzer mix, biggest of the three. I'd like her to have a purple collar. She is friendly but bold. She has a mohawk going down her back.

Dipper: Jack russell terrier. He is the middle size, he is also missing a leg (his back left leg). I'd like him to have a blue collar. He is very high energy.

Mabel: Chihuahua. She is the smallest, she has a very bossy/queen like personality. I'd like her to have a pink collar. 

Feel free to do whatever you'd like for the theme!

https://sta.sh/212p7se2qux2?edit=1

Hello master gatao! Nice to meet you! This is my very first time requesting a skeb. I really enjoy viewing your beautiful pet portraits. I have two dogs I love dearly - Latte (white shepherd mix) and Mocha (brown german shepherd). 
Please refer to this photo album for references: ( https://photos.app.goo.gl/4tpstvQpJ8sCdetUA )

Latte is a cheerful, playful, little-sister type. She has pink and black cow-patterned paws.
Mocha is a very strict and serious older sister. She has black paws.

I would like to request a drawing of my 2 dogs having a tea party, or maybe having yakiniku together. 
Any colors, composition, foods that you think would be fitting I would be very happy with. 

If possible, I would like the file in PSD as well. 

I understand that you have a busy schedule, so thank you very much for considering my request!

gatao様こんにちは。
いつも素敵なイラスト拝見しております。
リクエストできる機会を設けていただけて、大変嬉しい思いです。

以下、リクエストさせていただきたい内容です。
●布おばけのイラスト

幅広く曖昧なリクエストで恐れ入ります。
gataoさんの表現される色彩や構図がどれも大好きなため、
布おばけというモチーフをgataoさんの解釈で描いていただけると嬉しいです。

無理のない範囲でご検討いただけますと幸いです。
どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

Hello, I'm sorry to bother you! I like your lovely animal illustration very much. Can you draw this illustration for my OCs animal form (cat king and  rabbit)? Please refer to the link for specific introduction and animal form setting. Thank you very much!
https://sta.sh/21dszg04od1c

Hello, I love your animal and food artwork! I would love for you to draw my dog sammy and his favorite toy sitting at a table sharing a meal! His favorite foods are cake and chicken! He is a very happy and energetic dog. I will be printing the picture as a small poster and giving it as a gift if that's alright! (He does not have to be wearing the hat in the drawing.) The rest is up to you :D !!

Reference: https://imgur.com/a/JKZhHR7

https://imgur.com/a/JKZhHR7

Hello! I love your artwork so I want to request an illustration my original characters in animal forms. They are teenager couples and the girl(who is with black hair and has a mole under her lip) is the aggressive side of their relationship. Please draw freely!

Reference(animal):
https://imgur.com/gallery/5TuwGJ8

Reference(original):
https://twitter.com/Maple85379255/status/1435380932878405635

こんにちは、Gatao! あなたの最近のイラストを見て、すぐに好きになってしまいました。今回はそのイラストをお願いしたいと思います。

■内容
ラグドールと白黒のタキシード猫＋ハロウィンのお菓子を持ってピクニックをしているところです。
(動物の外観はこちらのページを参考にしてください。https://imgur.com/gallery/fTRyP8l)


できればPSDでの納品、アドレスは別レイヤーでお願いします。

https://imgur.com/gallery/fTRyP8l

Hello! I adore your art work.
I'm not sure if you draw real life pets / animals but I wanted to request hoping that you do.

Can you please draw my 3 cats in a 16:9 
wallpaper size? 
Cat 1 is very grouchy and mean.
Cat 2 is anxious, dumb, and very playful.
Cat 3 is loving, playful and always sleeping. Also has fluffy tail and paws.

I'm not sure of photo composition but Id like something pretty, and or cozy, like a bedroom.
I love the color pink, sweets (cake, snacks, sodas) eggs (can be decoration), and ghost motifs.
You could do whatever you'd think would look cute and I'd be very grateful.

I also apologize that my photo references may not be the best quality, but they're the only ones I have of my cats.
Thank you for your consideration! ♡

https://drive.google.com/folderview?id=1TUGmOOqaodj-FTMeCS4RUOIxvFRr7XxV

Hello! I really like your picture!
I hope you draw a picture of [cute animal + delicious looking food/fruit/drink + warm looking tones]!
Other elements can be free for you to use.
I will print out the drawing and decorate it for my own enjoyment at home.
https://skeb.jp/@arigatao_o/works/1
https://skeb.jp/@arigatao_o/works/5
https://skeb.jp/@arigatao_o/works/7
I really like these three paintings, and I'd be happy if I could follow a similar style to these three! Thanks!
In PSD form if possible, with the recipient on a separate layer, much appreciated!

gatao様はじめまして( ´͈ ᵕ `͈ )♡
ご多忙中申し訳ありませんが、ぜひイラストを依頼したくリクエストしてみました。

■内容
ラグドールと黒柴+ピクニック
（動物の外見はこちらをご参考になさってください：https://skeb.jp/@agrx0/works/1）

可能であれば納品はPSD・宛名などは別レイヤーでお願いします。
受けるのが難しいようであればキャンセルして頂いて全然構いませんので、よろしければご一考お願いいたします( ´͈ ᵕ `͈ )♡

Hi I love your soft colors and cute animal art. Could you please draw a fox and a lion playing with a black ghost with green eyes and a green mouth? They can drink tea and sing karaoke. Please consider me!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1jlkWnGGahK0iHi80IfzMuD4Anog8c7Lc?usp=sharing

Hi there, I'd like to ask for your help. I have been asked to create a wonderful illustration for you to view and enjoy as a desktop image.
I would be happy if you could draw it freely, incorporating the following information.
I love gatao's illustrations.
I love gatao's illustrations and get a smile on my face every time they are uploaded. I'm looking forward to working with you.

Hello Gatao先生 ! Your work is so so beautiful!

If possible, I would like you to draw my character Lajpat.
https://toyhou.se/1756594.lajpat
She has a cute small form, with a weird (cute) long body and a weird (cute) long neck!
As Lajpat is a deity, she likes delicious food! So a drawing with some food and cuteness would be really good.

Thank you very much!!

Hello! I'm Rainbow Jr. 
I am a clown. I'm very small like a mascot character. 
I'd like for me to be drawn in a circus tent, illuminated by the tent lights. Thank-you so much! (´▽`ʃ♡ƪ)


https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rSC9Dth2yVVXmZtOggvxRH1iLwHZWYzg?usp=sharing

Hello! Your style is so cute. I love how you delicious you draw food too. I  would like to request an illustration to use for my stream(twitch) and SNS. If possible, please deliver as PSD format and in 16:9 ratio. 

The animal mascot is my VTUBER character, NIKO. (Please draw him as animal and include his earrings.)  He is a mischievous and playful fox that is always hungry for good food. I would like the illustration to include food please. His favorites include any type of meat. The illustration can have the feeling of enjoying a feast or excited to eat!

If possible please include his fox cell phone somewhere in illustration. If not, that is okay!

Everything else I leave up to you.
Thank you! 💓

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1wd33MO5nx9_qdslgGMYvfqbaSFUYcy-4

Hi, I absolutely adore your work!! I was wondering if I could get a picture made for my Twitch streams?  It would be a picture in the dimension 16:9 (1920 x 1080px)! I was wondering if I could get something similar to this picture? https://twitter.com/arigatao_o/status/1357250785784995842/photo/1
Could it feature my bunny sprout  with similar setting on the table? Maybe it could be pancakes, coffee/tea ect? Whatever you think would look best! Could it also feature multiple smaller bunnies that look the same and are running around being mischievous? Thank you so much!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xkZw7txYd0U1JBTNTA2_Ky09fuNjUWZr/view?usp=sharing
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FbUOFb3PYJT2bTkaT-QBPh5wJcdeXAyI/view?usp=sharing
